allow.name: start_backend
args: $exe = if ((Split-Path -Leaf (Get-Location)) -eq 'src-tauri') { '../backend/output/backend.exe' } else { './backend.exe' }; try { Invoke-RestMethod -Uri 'http://127.0.0.1:5000/' -TimeoutSec 1 | Out-Null } catch { Start-Process -FilePath $exe -WindowStyle Hidden }

allow.name: stop_backend
args: try { Invoke-RestMethod -Uri 'http://127.0.0.1:5000/shutdown' -Method Post -Headers @{'X-PrintNum-Shutdown'='local-client'} -TimeoutSec 2 | Out-Null } catch { Write-Output 'Backend shutdown endpoint is unavailable.' }
